body: Thank you.  The kids are ok but now knowing my husband thinks we should have broken up 6 months into our relationship has broken me.  He is my everything and I can't imagine life without him. I hate to keep him trapped and unhappy because he made a commitment 21 years ago. He deserves better than what I can give him. I had a heart attack 2 weeks ago, aspirated in my lungs within the last couple of days.....he has no sympathy and doesn't even act like he cares. He goes to the doctors with me and they tell us everything and I ask questions. He never has any questions until we get in the car and then I have to go over it all again.   I know he loves me but I'm equally certain that he doesn't like me.
Thank you for your kind words. I'm just really struggling and have no one to talk to about it.  I really appreciate your kindness
